checks.name: plan-and-candidate-lineage
checks.command: uv run factory/validators/validate_plan.py --file plans/recursive-learner-reentry.md && uv run factory/validators/validate_candidate.py --file factory-artifacts/recursive-learner-reentry-candidate.json

findings: The candidate resolves the deepest learner before closure lookup, keys closure state by owner, surface, and output, and validates that identity and ancestry on checkpoint restore.
Frozen root construction, exact replay, natural quiescence, false-closure rejection, all 24 active core tests, and strict software checks remain intact.
After construction the learner owns the participating surface, and ordinary activity produces both a real motor output and modulatory return incidence through public Harness operations.
The post-construction return does not reach reverse consolidation or an owner-bearing causal-closure event, so owner-specific closure identity alone cannot construct a descendant.
The planned depth-three outcome is refuted at child-owned closure genesis; the dependent composition arm and later capability rungs were correctly not run.
residual_uncertainty: The public trace localizes the break before reverse consolidation but does not yet distinguish return scheduling from physical-origin admission inside that boundary.
Construction-scoped reopening and owner-plus-participation-scoped eligibility remain untested competing mechanisms.
No descendant construction, local control, nested consequence, recruitment, sibling composition, body composition, or authority claim is supported.
